summary: Validated iteration 25 changes: (1) Login/Register password-eye toggles, (2) Accounting page 5-tab reorganization (Customer | Credits | Accounts | Expenses | GST), (3) GST section with Paid + Input + Net snapshot cards, (4) CEO Dashboard Net Cash Flow removal and symmetric layout, (5) Backend /api/accounts accepts gst_paid and /api/accounts/summary exposes gst_paid_mtd, gst_input_mtd, gst_net_mtd, operational_expense_mtd.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/accounts returns only {id, message} without echoing the created entry — consider returning the full resource for better REST semantics and easier frontend state updates, though tests/frontend work fine with the current shape.
CustomerCreditsPage.js uses `fetch` as a variable name inside useCallback which shadows the built-in — rename to `loadCredits` for clarity (not a functional bug).
seed_data_creation: Created & cleaned up a TEST_gst_paid entry and a TEST_gst_input entry via API during test run (self-cleaning).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 25 small-change set fully verified (eye toggles, 5-tab accounting, CEO dashboard net-cash-flow removal + symmetric layout, gst_paid backend support). Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_gst_accounts.py uses a requests.Session with Bearer token from /api/auth/login response and falls back to cookie auth automatically. Reusable pattern for future backend tests. Frontend screenshot of CEO dashboard confirms: 8 KPI cards (2x4), 4 snapshot cards (cash/opexp/gst/balance), readings card in 3-col row, no Net Cash Flow strip anywhere.
